protocol.intervention: Both current and goal inputs use ordinary grid code. Selected LSTM components are replaced by their mixed-code values computed from the same actual preceding h/c. Recurrent state and behavior then evolve normally.
protocol.controls: intact restores all four components; both_grid restores none. All branches use the same explicit LSTM update, checked against the original cell, and share environmental layouts/noise and action uniforms.
protocol.interpretation: Causal pathway intervention at evaluation, not retraining. Restored components have access to counterfactual predictive code; this is not a pure grid-input policy. Gate contributions interact.

statistics: Eight training-seed means are replicates. Paired t intervals and tests; exact two-sided sign flips. Holm correction within each ten-comparison outcome family. Recovery fraction is a ratio of group-mean differences, descriptive, not a per-seed average or proof of mediation. The input+forget pair control was added after inspecting early rescue results; it reproduces the common baseline episode records exactly.
